title_en: Interim Provisions on the Management and Use of Welfare Funds for State Organ Staff

articles.content_en: I. The standards for welfare funds for staff shall be otherwise specified in detail based on the different circumstances of the salary levels of staff in organs at all levels and the urban and rural living standards.

II. The welfare funds for staff of central organs shall, after necessary adjustments by the Personnel Bureau of the State Council, be managed and used by the personnel work departments of each organ; the welfare funds for staff of local organs shall, after necessary adjustments by the personnel bureaus (divisions) of the people's committees of each province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government within their respective provincial, regional, or municipal jurisdictions, be uniformly managed and used by the personnel work departments at or above the county level.
The year-end surplus of welfare funds for staff shall in no case be turned over to the higher authorities, but shall not be diverted to other uses.

IV. Where staff members have difficulties in meeting their own living expenses (which shall vary according to positions) and the living expenses of their family members (generally determined according to the people's living standards in the place where the family members reside) from their salary income and other economic income, or have difficulties due to medical expenses for family members' illness, burial expenses for family members' death, or have other special difficulties, they shall be granted periodic or temporary subsidies as appropriate in accordance with the principle of 'greater subsidies for greater difficulties and smaller subsidies for smaller difficulties.'
When welfare funds still have a surplus after solving various difficulties of staff, they may appropriately subsidize the expenses needed for collective welfare.

V. Various difficulty subsidies for staff shall be applied for by the staff member himself/herself, and after evaluation by the welfare organization of the organ, shall be determined upon consultation with the personnel work department of the organ.

VI. The people's committees of each province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government may, in accordance with the spirit of these Provisions and in light of the specific local circumstances, make specific provisions.

VII. These Provisions shall come into effect as of June 1, 1957. The Notice on the Measures for the Management and Use of Welfare Funds for Staff of People's Governments at All Levels issued by the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government in March 1954 and the Supplementary Notice on the Management and Use of Welfare Funds for Staff of People's Governments at All Levels issued by the State Council in December 1954 shall be abolished simultaneously.
